content: Hey, hope your day wasn't too exhausting! I've been thinking about you nonstop. How was work today?
Hey! Work was intense as usual, but your messages always make it better. How did your first week at the new job go?
Honestly, it's been an adjustment, but I'm grateful for the opportunity. Everyone seems nice, but nothing compares to chatting with you. Hope that doesn't sound too sappy.
That's sweet of you. I'm glad we have each other to talk to, even when things get busy.
I feel lucky every day to have you in my life. You're such a bright spot for me. I wish I could do something special for you right now.
You already do a lot just by being here for me. I wish I could help you relax after your crazy week.
Actually, I wanted to talk to you about something. It's a bit embarrassing, but I know I can trust you. Can I share?
Of course, you can tell me anything. What's going on?

So, I just started the new job and my first paycheck won't come through for almost three weeks. I budgeted, but I miscalculated groceries and a couple bills. I hate to ask, but could you spot me just enough to get by until payday? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I get paid.
Oh, I didn't realize your pay wouldn't come in right away. How much do you need? I wish I could do more, but I can help if it's not a lot.

Thank you so much. You've got the kindest heart. If you could send $150, that would cover my groceries and utilities until next week. I know it's a lot to ask, but our connection means everything to me and I'd never take advantage of your kindness.
I can manage that. What's the best way to send it to you?

I really appreciate you, truly. The easiest for me is CashApp, my handle is $RealJames24. If you could send it there, I'll pay you right back when I get my check. If you don't have CashApp, I also have a Coinbase wallet for crypto. Let me know what works best for you.
I have CashApp, so I'll send it to $RealJames24. Do you need anything else from me?

That's perfect! Just make sure you select the 'friends and family' option so there aren't any weird fees. If you need a screenshot of my profile, let me know! I'll be watching for it and will let you know as soon as it comes through.
Alright, I just sent it. Let me know if you get it, okay?
You're amazing! I just got the notification, thank you. I know it's a lot to trust me with this, but I promise I'll make it up to you. You mean so much to me.
It's okay, I trust you. I just want you to be alright. Let me know when you're back on your feet.
You're seriously the best. I can't wait until we can finally celebrate together. You have no idea how much this helps. I'll update you as soon as my paycheck lands.
